# AI search optimization (Marketing Skills)

Helps your content get cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude and Google AI Overviews.

- Source: https://github.com/coreyhaines31/marketingskills
- SKILL.md: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/coreyhaines31/marketingskills/main/skills/ai-seo/SKILL.md
- Author: Corey Haines
- License: MIT
- Page: https://commandvault.ai/commands/ai-search-optimization-marketing-skills-20cfa95a

Covers 'answer engine' optimization: how AI search picks sources, how to audit your current AI visibility, and which content formats and structures get cited most. It also covers machine-readable assets like llms.txt and agent-friendly pricing pages. References and evals are included.

**Try asking:**
- "How do I show up in ChatGPT answers for my category?"
- "Audit our AI search visibility"
- "Write an llms.txt for our docs site"
